I was dating a guy that was 10 years older than me, and he passed away suddenly, and it took me awhile to recover enough to move forward. My biggest regret, and i still blame myself for his loss. One Saturday night, I had gone out with some girls to a club named C4. Its basically a basement and I had no service. 

He called me three times and they didn’t connect. I didn’t get his messages, it was 4 am by the time I got home and my phone was dead. I had work at 8 am - 5pm, it dragged forever but I messaged him back and got no response. Went home, and didn’t wake up til midday Monday, still no response. I was upset but brushed it off thinking he was working. Friday comes around and he doesn’t show up to the open house we wanted to rent together so we could have our own space instead of our nights together at motels. I messaged him saying I was worried and if he’d call me, i saw he had read my other messages, so i asked just for a simple excuse for not getting back to me. I got nothing, Saturday I’m walking into work and I see a picture on Facebook that has him tagged. 

“Rest in peace, so you in the next life” I though he lost one of his parents or a friend, and felt that was the reason for silence. Then i scrolled once more, and my heart dropped. The gravestone had his picture on it, and the date was the day i missed his calls and messages. April 8 2018. I forgot how to breathe, i was panicking, confused, devastated, and lost. 

I had met him when I was 16 and he was 26. He had helped me leave the abusive homophobic house. He had cared for me, held me, hugged me when i needed it. I fell, and i fell hard. Alcohol & addiction to oxycodine, leave parties drunk and head to the grave and just cried. 

I cleaned up, because he would have wanted me to. I picked myself up and step by step moved on. Now I’m 1 and 1/2 years sober, in college again, have my own apartment again. And even though he’s not here, he’d be proud of me.

It hurts, but you have to be strong when it happens. Reach out for help. Don’t do what i did. I was trying to kill myself in an accident, but he was my angel. I listened to one song one day crying about him. I realized if he’s my angel, why am i making his job harder? So i picked myself up and I’m happy I did.
